D: A farmer from a village of little people is chosen to carry a special baby to safety.
P: Serve the snacks when Willow first meets Madmartigan in the crow's cage at the crossroads.
S: Bocconcini rolled in toasted hazelnut and chives, drizzled with honey
Bocconcini rolled in crushed toasted hazelnuts and chives so they look like acorns, with a little honey to drizzle.
Warm homemade rolls served with parsley and chive butter
Soft bread rolls brushed with butter, baked at 200C for 18 minutes, served warm with herb butter and a soft cheese.
M: Crossroads tavern beef and root veg stew
Beef chuck, carrots and parsnips simmered 3 hours in tomato beef stock

Beef chuck braised with onion, carrot, parsnip, thyme and bay in a rich beef stock until tender, served in bowls with crusty bread and butter. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Add a sliced onion, 3 carrots and 2 parsnips in chunks and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 1 tbsp flour and 2 tbsp tomato paste, then 1L beef stock, thyme and a bay leaf. Cover and simmer for 3 hours until the beef is tender and the sauce is rich. Serve in bowls with crusty bread and butter.

Pork shoulder scored and rubbed with salt and fennel seed, roasted slow until tender, the crackling blasted until it shatters, with roast apples and potatoes. Score the skin of a 2kg pork shoulder, rub with salt and 2 tsp crushed fennel seeds and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Roast at 160C for 4 hours. Add 1kg potatoes and 4 halved apples tossed in oil for the last hour. Turn up to 240C for 25 minutes until the crackling blisters. Rest 15 minutes and carve.
W: Blackberries pressed into almond cream in a sweet pastry shell

Sweet pastry filled with almond cream and dark blackberries, baked until bubbling and golden, dusted with icing sugar and served with thick cream. Line a 23cm tart tin with sweet shortcrust and chill 20 minutes. Beat 100g soft butter with 100g caster sugar, then 2 eggs and 100g almond meal. Spread in the case and press in 300g blackberries. Bake at 180C for 40 minutes until golden and set. Cool, dust with icing sugar and serve with thick cream.
Franjean and Rool, the troublesome brownies

Tiny crisp pastry cases filled with vanilla whipped cream and piled with mixed berries tossed in sugar and lemon zest, finished with icing sugar. Cut 2 sheets of sweet shortcrust into 24 rounds and press into a mini muffin tray. Prick and bake at 190C for 12 minutes until golden, then cool. Toss 300g mixed berries with 1 tbsp caster sugar and the zest of a lemon. Whip 200ml cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar and vanilla. Spoon cream into the cases, pile on the berries and dust with icing sugar.
K: Warm apple juice with cinnamon, cloves, orange peel and honey

Cloudy apple juice warmed slowly with cinnamon, cloves, orange peel and a little honey, ladled into mugs with an apple slice. Pour 1.5L cloudy apple juice into a pot with 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 whole cloves, a few strips of orange peel and 1 tbsp honey. Warm gently for 15 minutes without boiling so the spices come through. Strain out the cloves. Ladle into mugs and float a thin apple slice in each.
